title: dt/2 check, negative for robustness: at half the world time step (seed 620) mar-60 rods under birth-site depletion cover 4.36 own lengths per cycle against mar 40's 2.66, so loop 3's equal distance per cycle does not hold; the grid-scale stripes around mar-60 bodies persist at dt/2
summary: Repeated loop 3's single-kind depletion arms on seed 620 with the world step halved (dt 0.025, 200 steps per 5 t frame). Median D per cycle is 2.66 (mar 40) vs 4.36 (mar 60), cycles 180 and 215 t, against 3.69 vs 3.17 and 338 vs 305 t at dt 0.05. Loop 3's reading that the depletion step levels the trait's effect on distance per cycle is not robust to the time step on this seed and should be retested on more seeds. The stripes are not a time-step artefact.

finding.operator: birth-site depletion on single-kind Marangoni rods, world dt halved
finding.control: dt/2 of the world's own step (WORLD_P dt 0.025, --spf 200), seed 620
